parameters.content:
## 01 · Receive and parse command
Access → repeat protection → data → action choice

## 02 · Adding and management
Search creation; /on and /off

## 03 · Search deletion
Notifications: delete own, verify none of own remain → history → setting

## 04 · Reply and command log
Telegram confirmation → request text and actual response → update receipt_id

parameters.jsCode: const c=$("Parse command").first().json;const searches=$("Read searches").all().map(i=>i.json).filter(r=>r.search_id===c.search_id);if(c.action!=='delete'||typeof c.search_id!=='string'||!c.search_id||searches.length!==1)throw Error('Search to delete not confirmed');return [{json:{search_id:c.search_id}}];

const r=$input.first().json;if(r.statusCode!==200||!(r.body===true||r.body?.success===true))throw Error('The local API did not confirm the deletion');return [{json:$("IS Check deletion owner").first().json}];

const c=$input.first().json;if(c.name!=='service'||!Number.isFinite(c.interval_seconds)||c.interval_seconds<=0)throw Error('No common interval');const input=$('C Input').first().json;return [{json:{owner:String($execution.id),owner_workflow:String($workflow.id),interval_seconds:c.interval_seconds,enabled:c.enabled===true,input,needs_monitor:"commands"==='commands'&&/^\/(?:del(?:@[a-z0-9_]+)?(?:\s|$)|on$)/i.test(input.message?.text?.trim()||'')}}];
return $input.all();

const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);if(rows.length!==1||rows[0].name!=="commands"||typeof rows[0].owner!=='string')throw Error('Owner row corrupted');const r=rows[0];if(r.owner!=='free'&&(!/^[1-9]\d*$/.test(r.owner)||!r.owner_workflow))throw Error('Owner corrupted');return [{json:r}];

const r=$input.first().json,o=$('C Read').all(0,-1)[0].json,b=r.body||{},same=r.statusCode===200&&String(b.id)===o.owner&&String(b.workflowId)===o.owner_workflow;return [{json:{observed_owner:o.owner,known_live:same&&['running','new','waiting'].includes(b.status),recover:same&&['success','error','crashed','canceled'].includes(b.status),missing:r.statusCode===404}}];

return [{json:{owned:$input.all().some(i=>i.json.owner===$('C Plan').first().json.owner&&i.json.name==="commands")}}];
if($input.first().json.known_live===false)throw Error('Could not safely check the owner');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));return [{json:{retry:true}}];

return [{json:$('C Plan').first().json.input}];
if(!$input.all().some(i=>i.json.owner==='free'&&i.json.name==="commands"))throw Error('Owner release not confirmed');return [{json:{done:true}}];
return $("Parse command").all();
return [{json:{...$("PF Metrics 1 HTTP").first().json, read_at: new Date().toISOString()}}];
return [{json:{...$("PF Metrics 2 HTTP").first().json, read_at: new Date().toISOString()}}];
const r=$input.first().json;if(r.statusCode!==200||!(r.body===true||r.body?.success===true))throw Error('The local API did not confirm the queue cleanup');return [{json:{}}];

if($input.all().some(i=>i.json.id))throw Error('Queue not cleared');const ids=$("Read searches").all().map(i=>i.json.search_id).filter(Boolean);if(!ids.length)throw Error('No searches for silent baseline');return ids.map(search_id=>({json:{search_id}}));

const want=$("R Searches to reset").all().map(i=>i.json.search_id).sort();const got=$input.all().map(i=>i.json).filter(r=>r.search_id);if(JSON.stringify(got.map(r=>r.search_id).sort())!==JSON.stringify(want)||got.some(r=>r.initialized!==false||r.baseline_completed_at))throw Error('Silent baseline not recorded for all searches');return [{json:{}}];
